name: PT Perma Plasindo Tbk
summary: PT Perma Plasindo Tbk, along with its associated companies, is an Indonesian manufacturer and distributor of various office supplies. The firm provides a wide array of stationery, including office items marketed under labels such as Bantex, Elba, Linex, APLI, Oxford, and XYRON. For the education sector, it offers school stationery from brands like LYRA, GIOTTO, and Milan. Creative individuals can find fine arts and crafts supplies from Canson Paper, COPIC Marker, and DAS. General stationery products include Paper HVS Sinar Dunia, Globe, Paperline, and Paperline Gold. Beyond stationery, the company engages in the wholesale and distribution of chemical products, specifically industrial adhesives under the Stck-O brand, and is also active in information technology. Established in 1992, its headquarters are located in North Jakarta, Indonesia.
